manufacturer.name: Rytec
manufacturer.note: US manufacturer of high-performance commercial overhead doors. Serves its manuals as static PDFs from two hosts it controls - a documents directory on rytecdoors.com and an S3 bucket at ddn.rytecdoors.com - so the records below are the first batch in this library that are manufacturer-hosted almost throughout. Both hosts are registered as harvest targets.

models.name: Rytec Spiral SST / STT High-Performance Door

documents.title: Spiral SST and STT Installation Manual
documents.evidence: On rytecdoors.com, the manufacturer's own domain. Document number 1072125-0 read from the file name; the _1 suffix is the host's duplicate-upload marker, not part of the number. One manual covers the SST and STT, so both are on this record. Not fetched - egress blocked.

documents.title: Rytec Spiral HZ Installation Manual
documents.evidence: On ddn.rytecdoors.com, Rytec's own S3 document bucket - a manufacturer host despite the amazonaws.com address, which is why the origin is not third-party. Document number 0915016 is the whole file name. Not fetched - egress blocked.

documents.title: Spiral VP Direct Drive (SVP-D) Installation Manual
documents.evidence: On rytecdoors.com. The file name carries a date rather than a document number, so 2016-09-22 is recorded as the version - that is Rytec's own edition marker on the file, not a date this library inferred. Not fetched - egress blocked.
